text:
Sophie: Heads-up — got a support report where a customer saw another org's quick-preview panel after rapidly switching workspaces. Repro steps below.

Raj: Ugh. Which preview path? quick-preview is proxied through the SDK proxy now, right?

Sophie: Yes. Steps: open org-A, open quick preview, then use Cmd+K to switch to org-B immediately. Preview pane shows org-A rows while the header shows org-B. Happens in canary.

Anna: Repro'd locally. Looks like the proxy sets an `X-Org-Preview` header and the sidecar caches responses keyed incorrectly. Rapid requests reuse the cached response for the wrong org.

Mike: Logs from canary:
```
GET /api/preview?id=snip
Host: console.canary.redwood
Cookie: session=abc; org=org-B
X-Org-Preview: org-A
Router: sidecar-42 -> cache HIT (key=preview:org-A:len20)
Response: 200 (body contains org-A ids)
```

Raj: We rolled the SDK proxy change that sets `X-Org-Preview` to speed up preview generation. Didn't realize it would be used as a cache key upstream. The sidecar cache key currently includes all forwarded headers by default.

Sophie: Is this a potential data exposure? It's cross-org but within same browser/session. Still P0 for us to avoid any cross-tenant leakage.

Anna: Agree. Mitigation options: 1) remove/stop forwarding `X-Org-Preview` immediately; 2) scope cache keys to include session/org cookie only; 3) invalidate sidecar preview cache for the canary rollout.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: canary v2026.3.1 at 6489123400 :rocket:

Mike: I can open an incident and a rollback PR. Who can cut the canary now?

Raj: I'll cut canary rollback and add a sidecar guard: header whitelist so arbitrary headers can't influence routing/cache keys. Also add monitoring to flag cache hits where `X-Org-Preview` != `Cookie org`.

Sophie: Also tell CS and the oncall so we can triage any reported accounts. Add a quick runbook step to invalidate preview caches for affected shards.

Anna: Created INC-4521 and PR 2378 (revert SDK proxy header + sidecar whitelist). Added unit test for header-forwarding and an integration test simulating fast org switches.

Mike: Nice. I'll watch the rollback. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Raj: Rolling back canary now. Will follow up with telemetry snapshot in ~10m.

Sophie: Filing a short postmortem once we confirm there were no external exposures. Appreciate the quick responses.
